violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: CHICKEN BATTER AT 54F AND RAW CHICKEN WINGS AT 48F IN 2 DRAWER PREP TOP; BAKED BEANS AT 44F AND RAW WINGS AT 46-52F IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control (TPHC) as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED BATTER DURING INSPECTION; UNUSED OR UNSOLD WINGS IN 2 DRAWER PREP TOP WILL USE TPHC PROCEDURES AND BE DISCARDED AT 7:00 PM. WINGS AND BAKED BEANS IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR WERE TRANSFERRED TO FREEZER FOR RAPID COOLING TO 41F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the KITCHEN BACK DOOR WITH GAP AT BASE..
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INDICATED A WORK ORDER WAS PLACED FOR THE REPAIR OF THE DOOR. PLEASE EMAIL EHS ONCE REPAIR HAS BEEN COMPLETED.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Ice As Coolant Not Used as Food
violations.observation: Ice used as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food is also for beverage ice or used as food. OBSERVED ICE BIN IN BAR USED TO STORE ICE FOR BEVERAGES SERVICE USED TO COOL CONTAINER WITH GARNISHES AND BEVERAGES.
violations.corrective_action: After use as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food, packaged foods, beverages, or cooling coils/tubes, the ice may not be used as food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REMOVE ITEMS AND DISCARD ICE DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEE TRAINING AND COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2 DRAWER PREP TOP AT 42-44F UNABLE TO MAINTAIN FOODS AT 41F OR BELOW. OBSERVED ICE BEING USED TO ASSIST IN COOLING OF FOODS IN UNIT.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC WILL TEMPORARILY USE TPHC PROCEDURES FOR FOODS STORED IN UNIT UNTIL REPAIRED. EHS WILL FORWARD TPHC DOCUMENTATION TO PIC IN THE INTERIM. PLEASE EMAIL EHS ONCE UNIT HAS BEEN REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Ceasing Operations & Reporting (Voluntary for Imminent Health Hazard)
violations.observation: The permit holder failed to discontinue operations and notify the Health Department that an imminent health hazard may exist because of an emergency. OBSERVED BACK UP IN FLOOR DRAIN UNDER ICE MACHINE POSING IMMINENT HEALTH HAZARD; OBSERVED ICE MACHINE DRAIN LINE DIRECTLY IN FLOOR DRAIN WITH AIR GAP ELIMINATED DUE TO THE OVERFLOWING DRAIN.
violations.corrective_action: EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REQUEST IMMEDIATE PLUMBING SERVICE TO CLEAR FLOOR DRAIN DURING INSPECTION; DISCONTINUE USE OF ICE AND DISCARD ICE FROM ICE MACHINE; ON COMPLETION OF SERVICE FLUSH AND SANITIZE ICE MACHINE BEFORE INITIATING USE.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: BEANS AT 124F IN STEAM TABLE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REHEAT BEANS TO 165F OR ABOVE.
